title: Make quality assessments source-aware and profile-specific
scope: Fixture-only review of the structured assessment path: contributor_tools/common/data_contract.py (inspect_contract, assess_observations), contributor_tools/common/config_manager.py (ValidationConfigManager task metadata) and contributor_tools/DATA_CONTRACT.md (read only). No research dataset or converted_datasets/ content was read; no numerical or MATLAB job was launched.

fixture.label: synthetic
fixture.design: One invented subject S01, recording synthetic/trial-1, constant knee_flexion_angle_ipsi_rad of 0.5 rad on the inclusive 150-sample phase grid, profile range 0-1 rad at 0 and 100 percent. Expected states follow from the constant values (0.5 inside, 2.0 outside, NaN missing, inf invalid) without running the assessment.

method: Probed existing behavior first; added code only where a fixture showed a false pass or missing lineage. The new test file was run against the pre-change module (HEAD copy swapped in temporarily, then restored): 19 of 41 tests failed, exactly the three new safeguards; the other 22 pass on both versions and document existing behavior.

acceptance.item: Unsupported source identities, anatomy, mass, timing and laterality are not invented or converted into passing data.
existing_behavior: Missing source_recording_id/observation_id stay unreviewed and unpublishable (test_data_contract::test_legacy_missing_ids_remains_unreviewed).
Numeric subject is rejected, not stringified (new: test_numeric_subject_is_not_silently_stringified).
Cycle sides unknown/Left/ipsi/affected are unreviewed, not mapped to left/right; limb-indexed cycle with side none is rejected and kept as none.
Body-weight-normalized signal is checked exactly as supplied; no mass is read, invented or used for rescaling.
Unavailable source clocks (both NaN) remain unavailable.

gaps_found_and_fixed.demonstration: subject/source_recording_id/observation_id equal to 'nan', 'None', '<NA>', ' NaN ' or 'null' were publishable and passed (probe before fix: counts passed=1).
gaps_found_and_fixed.fix: inspect_contract rejects these tokens (case- and whitespace-insensitive, plus 'nat') for the three source identity columns. reference_side keeps its explicit 'none'.

gaps_found_and_fixed.demonstration: An ensemble_curve with source_start_time_s=0.0 and source_end_time_s=1.1 (an assumed stride duration) passed and was publishable.
gaps_found_and_fixed.fix: inspect_contract rejects finite source event bounds on ensemble_curve observations; both-unavailable bounds remain valid. Existing ensemble converter pilot (Fukuchi 2018) writes NaN bounds, so it is unaffected (read from code, not data).

acceptance.item: The schema supports complete recording and exclusion accounting.
acceptance.evidence: test_every_observation_is_accounted_for_once: four identities (including same observation_id on the other side and a malformed 149-sample cycle) yield four observation records; state counts sum to total_observations; every non-eligible record carries reasons. Every record carries source_recording_id, so recordings are recoverable from identities.
acceptance.not_covered: A source recording that yields zero observations cannot appear in the observation table; reconciling the provenance source list against observed source_recording_id values belongs to the release builder and per-dataset source-readback tasks.

acceptance.item: Distinguish passed, failed, missing, unchecked and invalid with explicit source, side and time lineage.
acceptance.existing_behavior: The five states were already distinct (test_data_contract::test_required_missing_invalid_unchecked_and_failed_are_distinct); each record carried the identity (source recording and reference side).

gaps_found_and_fixed.demonstration: Observation records had keys eligible, identity, observation_type, profile_applicability, reasons, row_count, signals, status, task, task_id; no time information, so a failed or excluded observation could not be traced to its source clock.
gaps_found_and_fixed.fix: Each record now has time_lineage {index_column, index_first, index_last, source_start_time_s, source_end_time_s}. Values come only from the supplied columns; unavailable, nonconstant or nonfinite values are null, never computed.

acceptance.evidence: test_each_state_reports_source_side_and_time_lineage (all five states, alternating sides, distinct clocks), test_unavailable_clock_lineage_stays_unavailable, test_time_observation_lineage_reports_recorded_clock (shuffled rows; first/last 10.0/10.02 s).

acceptance.item: 150 inclusive phase samples, valid real clocks and source bounds without fabricating ensemble duration.
acceptance.evidence: Existing: phase length/grid/duplicate/NaN/nonnumeric checks (test_data_contract). New: ensembles with 149 or 151 samples rejected; time observations with repeated, NaN or single timestamps rejected and not repaired; ensemble finite source bounds rejected (above).

acceptance.item: Profile applicability explicit for population, protocol, task, unit, reference and observation type; mismatches and absent rules remain unchecked.
acceptance.result: pass for declared rules; one documented exception (see open_questions)
evidence: population and protocol mismatch -> unchecked, 0 executed checks.
reference: applicability on reference_side (right vs a left cycle) -> unchecked.
sign: an undeclared sign_rule against a profile requiring rule B -> unchecked.
unit: units live in feature names; a _deg column is never converted to the _rad rule (required _rad missing, _deg unchecked, not eligible).
observation type: transfer and ensemble_curve outside observation_types -> unchecked.
absent signal rule: a required signal with no range is unchecked and the observation cannot qualify.

acceptance.item: Fixture/schema completion does not approve any dataset.
acceptance.evidence: No dataset was read. Each dataset still needs its own source comparison and applicability/limitations review.

sign_dependence: Range checks are sign-dependent: a knee flexion range such as 0-1 rad assumes the adopted rule B (docs/reference #signs-and-frames: joint angles and moments positive in their named direction, knee flexion +). The assessment cannot detect a sign error that stays inside a range. Profiles may require a declared sign rule through applicability; no current profile or data column declares one, so this is offered as an option, not enforced.

open_questions.question: Should a profile with no applicability block stay usable for release filtering?
open_questions.fact: Synthetic stroke-labelled cycle passes a profile with no applicability metadata; the result carries a limitation string only. This is documented contract behavior, so it was not changed.
options: Keep: legacy profiles apply with a visible limitation.
Require applicability for releases: profiles without it leave every observation unchecked (filtered exports would be empty until profiles declare population/protocol).

open_questions.question: Transfers (and ensembles) with reference_side none may carry _ipsi_/_contra_ columns; ipsi has no stated anatomical reference then.
open_questions.fact: Allowed by the current contract text; not changed.

open_questions.question: Mass-normalized signals (_BW, _Nm_kg, _W_kg) have no structural check that a source mass was recorded.
open_questions.fact: The assessment neither invents nor uses mass. Enforcement would need a convention for where mass provenance is declared.

handoff_requests.release_builder_owner_CORE-05: exclusions.parquet does not yet carry time_lineage; quality.json does via the assessment records. Adding source_start_time_s/source_end_time_s columns to the exclusion ledger is optional and left to that task.
handoff_requests.DATA_CONTRACT.md_text: Done in CORE-01 after CORE-05 released the file: all three rules added in their sections.
